scope.rationale: D-02 freezes the shared legacy-vs-typed-column oracle. The only compiled input is the new projection-contract test class; it pins the exact legacy and by-name SqlFunctions.Column<T> SQL (aliases, value order, UNPIVOT roles) plus test-only fixture data. Its affected subset is that single class in the SQL Server test project; no production file is touched, so the inner loop is one filtered run over the class.
scope.boundary: Single post-implementation boundary planned for D-07: full per-project test sweeps plus the six-provider container integration run (C07/C08/C11); not executed by D-02.
